Optimize the supplied quantum circuit, minimizing CX count while preserving the full
operation up to global phase on all input states. Keep the same qubit count and output order.
No extra wires, reset, or measurement. You may return the input if you cannot improve it.
Return only a JSON array of gates in execution order. Gate forms:
["cx", control, target], ["h", q] (also x, y, z, s, sdg, t, tdg),
["rx", q, angle] (also ry, rz, p), or ["u", q, theta, phi, lambda].
All angles are multiples of pi, e.g. ["rz", 0, 0.25] means RZ(pi/4).
When copying a parameterized gate, retain its supplied precision.
The final array is evaluated independently. Use the input and feedback provided here.
